subject: MAP: Integration milestone lanes & owners — SDK / streaming / tool-calls
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Beth Gilmore <beth.gilmore@acme-health.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-01-10T16:12:00Z
Subject: MAP: Integration milestone lanes & owners — SDK / streaming / tool-calls

Hi Beth — thanks for hopping on today. Quick recap from our discovery + proposed next steps so we’re aligned for the MAP draft: 

Summary of what we heard
- Primary goal: embed Redwood inference into Acme Health’s clinician workflow for triage summaries and chart augmentation.
- Success metric: <20% downstream edit rate on generated summaries for first 90 days.
- Constraint: must run in Acme’s VPC for PHI; latency SLO target 300ms p50 for short requests.

Proposed MAP milestones (owner in parentheses) — these are focused on the integration build lane (SDK / streaming / tool-calling / structured outputs):
1) Private VPC onboarding & connectivity test (Acme infra / Redwood infra-team) — target: 2026-02-05
2) SDK drop-in POC and auth flow (Redwood: Rishi) — deliverable: sample app that calls streaming generate + auth tokens — target: 2026-02-12
3) Streaming KV/cache validation with clinical sequence (Acme + Redwood) — deliverable: performance report and recommended batching policy — target: 2026-02-19
4) Tool-calling & structured-output schema design (Joint: Product owners) — deliverable: OpenAPI + JSON schema for tools & structured outputs — target: 2026-02-26
5) End-to-end QA + compliance checklist (Acme security + Redwood compliance) — deliverable: signed checklist, audit artifacts — target: 2026-03-05
6) Production readiness sign-off & cutover window (Acme Eng + Redwood Ops) — target close date: 2026-03-12

Dependencies / risks
- KMS/HSM integration timeline (Acme): blocks VPC deployment until keys are provisioned.
- Sequence length in clinical notes (Acme): may require quantized model variant for cost/latency tradeoffs.
- Tool-calling schema freeze: late changes will impact SDK and streaming contract.

Immediate asks/action items
- Beth: confirm the Acme infra point of contact for VPC and KMS so we can schedule the connectivity test (reply with name + calendar availability).
- Rishi: I’ll assign SDK POC owner — can you confirm bandwidth for a 2-week focused POC starting 2/2?
- Beth & Product: confirm whether the tool outputs must follow FHIR-like schema or if a simplified JSON payload is acceptable.

I attached the MAP draft (MAP_v1_AcmeHealth.pdf) and a lightweight SDK checklist (sdk-integration-checklist.xlsx). Also shared the post-call recording link.

If that looks good I’ll fold this into the MAP doc and propose the target close date (3/12) formally.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_v1_AcmeHealth.pdf (application/pdf), sdk-integration-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet), post-call-recording.mp4 (link)

From: Beth Gilmore <beth.gilmore@acme-health.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Integrations Team <integrations@acme-health.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-01-11T09:34:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP: Integration milestone lanes & owners — SDK / streaming / tool-calls

Hi Vivek — thanks for the clear recap. That aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications and notes from the Acme side: 

1) VPC/KMS: point of contact is Samir Patel (samir.patel@acme-health.com). He’s out Thurs–Fri this week but available next Mon/Tue morning. KMS provisioning is estimated as a 2-week window after we provide the MFA and IAM list.

2) SDK POC: we can allocate a backend engineer, Priya Kapoor, for the POC. Priya can start the second week of Feb (2/9) — slightly later than your proposed 2/2. Is a 2/9 start workable?

3) Structured outputs: we’d prefer a FHIR-ish payload for tools that feed into EHR ingestion. We’ll send a short sample schema by 1/14.

4) Compliance artifacts: legal needs a brief on data retention policy and what logs Redwood will surface in the private deployment for audits.

Next steps: I’ll loop Samir and Priya on scheduling and we’ll aim to sign the MAP_v1 once we have the KMS timeline confirmed.

—Beth
Beth Gilmore
Director, Clinical Integrations — Acme Health

Thanks all — quick calendar items and agreements so we don’t lose momentum: 

- Samir: can we do the VPC connectivity test w/ Redwood infra on 2026-02-03 at 10:00 PT? If that works I’ll send the invite and pre-reqs checklist.
- Priya: thanks for starting 2/9 for the SDK POC; Rishi will send the POC plan next week — please share Priya’s preferred dev env and a sample clinical note by 1/22.
- Beth/Product: we’ll expect your sample FHIR-ish schema by 1/14; if you miss that date it will push the tool-calling schema freeze and may affect the 3/12 close date.

I’ve updated the MAP_v1 with the owner lanes and tentative dates; sharing the Drive link here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1Aq-MAP-v1-acme. Please comment directly in the doc and tag me for any disputes.

If we lock the VPC test and Priya’s start date I’ll mark the SDK POC milestone as committed in the MAP and send the formal MAP acceptance for signature.

Thanks — Vivek
